📋 COPY TO USB - COMMAND REFERENCE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Run these commands on DEVELOPMENT MACHINE (Linux/Mac):

# 1. Mount USB (replace /dev/sda1 if needed)
mkdir -p /media/usb
sudo mount /dev/sda1 /media/usb

# 2. Navigate to source directory
cd /home/lrqa/Desktop/viswa/Latest_Enhancement/Enhancement

# 3. Copy all deployment files
sudo cp rpi4-deploy.sh /media/usb/
sudo cp rpi4-setup-assistant.py /media/usb/
sudo cp USB_DEPLOYMENT_QUICK_START.py /media/usb/
sudo cp RPI4_QUICK_DEPLOYMENT_CARD.md /media/usb/
sudo cp RPI4_TERMINAL_COMMANDS.md /media/usb/
sudo cp docker-compose.yml /media/usb/
sudo cp requirements.txt /media/usb/

# 4. Copy Docker image (if ready - optional if very large)
sudo cp lrqa-middleware-latest.tar /media/usb/
# This may take 5-15 minutes depending on USB speed

# 5. Verify all files copied
ls -lh /media/usb/

# 6. Make scripts executable
chmod +x /media/usb/rpi4-deploy.sh
chmod +x /media/usb/USB_DEPLOYMENT_QUICK_START.py

# 7. Safely eject USB
sudo umount /media/usb
sudo eject /dev/sda


🎯 WHAT TO RUN ON NEW R-Pi 4
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

OPTION 1 - FASTEST (Copy & Paste This)
──────────────────────────────────────
mkdir -p /media/usb && sudo mount /dev/sda1 /media/usb && \
sudo bash /media/usb/rpi4-deploy.sh


OPTION 2 - INTERACTIVE
──────────────────────
python3 /media/usb/USB_DEPLOYMENT_QUICK_START.py


OPTION 3 - MANUAL CONTROL
──────────────────────────
sudo docker load -i /media/usb/lrqa-middleware-latest.tar
sudo docker run -d --name=lrqa-middleware -p 11078:11078 lrqa-middleware:latest


📍 USB FOLDER STRUCTURE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/media/usb/
├── rpi4-deploy.sh                    [Automated deployment]
├── rpi4-setup-assistant.py           [Interactive setup]
├── USB_DEPLOYMENT_QUICK_START.py     [One-command deploy]
├── RPI4_QUICK_DEPLOYMENT_CARD.md     [Quick reference]
├── RPI4_TERMINAL_COMMANDS.md         [Detailed commands]
├── docker-compose.yml                [Compose config]
├── requirements.txt                  [Python deps]
└── lrqa-middleware-latest.tar        [Docker image - ~12GB] (OPTIONAL)


✅ PRE-DEPLOYMENT CHECKLIST
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

On DEVELOPMENT MACHINE:
 □ Docker image is built and tagged as lrqa-middleware:latest
 □ All scripts are copied to USB
 □ All documentation is copied to USB
 □ Docker image exported to lrqa-middleware-latest.tar (or skip this step)
 □ USB is FAT32 or ext4 formatted
 □ All files are readable (chmod 644 for files, 755 for scripts)
 □ USB safely ejected after copying

On NEW R-Pi 4:
 □ R-Pi 4 is powered on and connected to network
 □ SSH access is available (or keyboard/monitor connected)
 □ USB is connected before or after boot
 □ Docker is installed (script will install if needed)


📊 FILE SIZE BREAKDOWN
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

REQUIRED (Total ~13 GB):
  Docker image              ~/.12 GB
  Scripts & Docs            ~100 KB
  
OPTIONAL (Total ~0 MB):
  Configuration files       ~2 KB


⏱️  ESTIMATED DEPLOYMENT TIME
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Preparation (on dev machine):      5-10 minutes
USB copy to R-Pi:                  5-15 minutes (depends on USB speed)
Docker load & start:               2-3 minutes
Total:                             ~15-30 minutes


⚠️  NOTES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Docker image is large (~12GB) - prepare adequate storage/USB speed
2. If Docker export is taking too long, skip copying the image
   - R-Pi will instead build/pull dependencies locally
   - This adds 5-10 minutes but is still manageable
3. First deployment takes longer; subsequent starts are <1 minute
4. Internet connection recommended (for package downloads if needed)
5. R-Pi 4 needs minimum 2GB free storage


🚀 QUICK START
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

TL;DR - Just run this on R-Pi:

    mkdir -p /media/usb && sudo mount /dev/sda1 /media/usb && \
    sudo bash /media/usb/rpi4-deploy.sh


That's it! Everything else happens automatically.
